candidates.title: Clear Account Sync Warning on Sign In
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen to feature account synchronization assurances and auto-recovery options for previous pet profiles.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign-in drop-off is 27.1%.

sign_in.headline: Sign In & Sync Your Pets
sign_in.body: Log in to link your desktop pet securely to your account and keep your progress safe.
sign_in.hint: Signing in ensures your pet won't disappear when re-launching the app.

components.text: Existing pet state will be restored automatically upon login.

guard.reason: Redesigns the sign-in screen with cloud sync assurances while maintaining all base rules and functional requirements.

candidates.score_note: High email volume (8) and 27.1% drop at sign_in indicate strong problem alignment.

candidates.title: Defer Sign In After Adoption Step
candidates.change: Move the sign-in screen after pet creation and adoption certificate generation, so users build emotional attachment before creating an account.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is only 60.9% with a median time of 89s, while sign-in early drops 27.1% of users before they even see a pet.

sign_in.headline: Save Your New Desktop Pet
sign_in.body: Sign in now to claim your adoption certificate and save your companion to the cloud.

guard.reason: Mentions gifts or free extras to incentivize signing in ("claim your adoption certificate").

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Control Guide Screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated desktop control tutorial screen right before finishing onboarding that demonstrates how to drag, summon, hide, and talk to the pet.
candidates.why: Users submitted 3 support tickets confused about how to control, hide or talk to their pet, and finish conversion is only 64.8%.

new_desktop_controls.headline: How to Interact with Your Pet
new_desktop_controls.body: Click and drag your pet on your desktop. Right-click the system tray icon to hide or open settings anytime.

components.text: Right-click tray icon to open menu
Press spacebar to bring pet to foreground

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready!
home_intro.body: Your pet is now active on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: Adding a new desktop controls guide screen before home intro is permitted under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Requires creating a new screen to address control confusion on finish step.

candidates.title: Real-Time Photo Quality Feedback Flow
candidates.change: Rebuild the photo upload screen to include live quality feedback and instant visual previews before submission.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failures or distorted visual outcomes, causing users to abandon adoption.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Photo for Custom Pet
upload_photos.body: Choose a clear, well-lit photo of your pet for best custom generation results.

guard.reason: 'upload_photos.replace.photo_upload[1]': a preview cannot do the photo_upload job (use ['button', 'checklist', 'image', 'photo_picker', 'text'])

candidates.title: Split View Path Selection Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the choose path screen into side-by-side comparative cards with time estimates and clear feature descriptions.
candidates.why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s despite median 8s, showing significant user hesitation during path choice.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Adoption Journey
choose_path.body: Pick a ready-made companion in 1 minute, or upload photos to create a custom pet.

components.text: Quick Pick (1 min) vs Custom Pet (3 min)

guard.reason: Two-column layout redesign retains both adoption paths (ready-made and custom) without violating fair design rules.

candidates.score_note: High mean time indicates user hesitation, though no support tickets were filed.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Spawn Tips on Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Add an engaging carousel of desktop placement tips and expected behavior notices to the generation waiting screen.
candidates.why: The waiting screen has a high mean time of 2336s, and 3 support emails reported pets not showing up on the desktop.

waiting.headline: Hatching Your Pet...
waiting.body: Your companion will appear floating directly on your desktop screen momentarily.

components.text: Tip: Make sure desktop overlay permissions are allowed if prompted.

guard.reason: Adds desktop placement tips to the waiting screen while preserving the pet creation waiting indicator.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long wait times on home step and 3 reports of missing pets.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Guidelines and Sample Hints
candidates.change: Add visible guidelines and bad/good photo examples below the upload box to assist custom pet generation.
candidates.why: 3 users emailed support due to failed pet generations or strange-looking custom results.

upload_photos.hint: Use clear, front-facing photos with good lighting. Avoid blurry or group shots.

components.text: Best results come from single-subject pet photos.

guard.reason: Adds helpful photo guidelines and sample assets to the upload screen without altering rules or pricing.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step has the highest drop-off (39.1%), so hints target a huge leaky bucket.

candidates.title: Home Intro Desktop Controls Summary Copy
candidates.change: Update the home intro text to prominently detail hotkeys and desktop tray controls.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails show post-onboarding confusion regarding hiding, summoning, or chatting with the desktop pet.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion!
home_intro.body: Your pet is now active on your screen. Right-click the system tray icon to hide, customize, or open settings anytime.

guard.reason: Updates home intro copy with desktop control instructions, which is part of onboarding under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Low cost text update addressing support confusion on desktop controls.

candidates.title: Spotlight Story Layout with Quick Skip
candidates.change: Switch the story screen layout to spotlight view with a direct action button to move quickly to path selection.
candidates.why: The mean time spent on choose_path/story step is disproportionately high (514s), indicating user idle time.

guard.reason: text in 'story.components[0].label' suggests skipping a step

candidates.title: Sign In Connection Status & Diagnostic Banner
candidates.change: Display an active connection status badge and retry trigger on the sign in screen to prevent blank screen stalls.
candidates.why: 2 support emails report the sign-in screen stalling or failing to load properly.

sign_in.hint: Having trouble connecting? Click retry to refresh authentication.

guard.reason: Adds connection status and retry option to the sign-in screen without modifying required functionality.

candidates.score_note: Diagnostic banner helps prevent stalls for the 27.1% drop on sign_in.
